blocks.x: I’m very happy to have Steve Turré with me today and my name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive. Thank you for joining me.
I see we both dressed up for the occasion, which I’m glad to see. And that is a beautiful coat you have on, I must say.
This is actually my summertime apparel but I wish it was warm instead of cold.
